violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Parental Notifications (26 TAC §744.501(6))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operational policies did not have the information for the parents righs listed. I spoke to the person in charge about this.

finding_variants.text: The operational policies did not have the information for the parents righs listed. I spoke to the person in charge about this.

Based on information obtained during the investigation, the operation did not follow their operational policy regarding children with challenging behaviors. The operation failed to provide required weekly behavior progress reports and did not develop individualized strategies to support the child.
The Operational Policies did not have information regarding parental notification or procedures for parents to review questions with the director.

The operational policy was reviewed and the following sections were not observed in the policy: Parent notification, transportation, water activities and field trips, permission for sunscreen/insect repellent, parent visits, parent participation, instructions for parent to contact Child Care Regulation, Abuse/Neglect hotline and website, parent rights, and the emergency preparedness plan.
